summary: Iter320 — Full E2E validation of new Duffel real-flights integration (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter331_duffel_flights.py with 13 pytest cases covering /live/search, /live/book, /bookings/{id}/eticket and regression on legacy mock endpoints. ALL 13 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend e2e on /vols also passed: client login -> 'Vols en direct' toggle -> FDF/ORY/2026-09-15 search returned 4 real Duffel offers -> selecting first offer, filling 1 passenger (Jean Dupont 1990-05-15) + contact email + phone +33612345678 -> booking succeeded with real PNR '3TQTED' -> success screen shows 'Télécharger l'e-billet' button -> 'Mes vols' lists the new Duffel reservation (Duffel Airways ZZ0403 · PNR 3TQTED · 264.76 EUR) with E-billet button. No critical issues found.

critical_code_review_comments: Good: backend properly normalises Duffel offer/slice/segment via _norm_offer/_norm_slice and stores offer_request with passenger_ids for later matching.

Good: wallet debit is atomic with order creation (insufficient balance is checked before Duffel create_order; if Duffel call fails after price check, no debit happens because debit is performed only after order success — verified in the code path lines 386-393).

Minor: in /live/book, the price is read from a fresh duffel.get_offer() so wallet check uses the live amount (correct). However if Duffel returns a different currency than EUR while wallet is EUR, code still debits the wallet's EUR balance with the foreign-currency amount (no FX conversion). Today routes return EUR for tested pairs (LHR/JFK and FDF/ORY both EUR) but worth a TODO comment in code for non-EUR offers.

Minor: the /vols select dropdown produces a hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') — not caused by Duffel work, pre-existing. Could fix by removing inner <span>/icon inside <option> elements.
Minor: /live/search currently caps offers at top 40 (offers[:40]) — fine for UX; consider exposing total count in response for pagination if needed later.

Observation: duffel.create_offer_request uses max_connections=1 (good for relevance), supplier_timeout=20000ms (reasonable). Token lives in backend/.env DUFFEL_API_KEY (test mode), never exposed to frontend — correct.
Observation: PDF generation via reportlab works (2.4KB+) with proper layout (navy header, orange PNR, slice cards, passengers list).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + toggle + live search + live book + Mes vols all pass)
